tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: Find lettering font IDs and licenses for PNG/SVG, or style IDs for copyable Unicode.

tools.name: convert_text
tools.description: Turn English letters into copyable decorative Unicode. Preserve accents, digits and emoji.

tools.name: render_lettering
tools.description: Generate actual transparent PNG lettering or an SVG with outlined glyphs. Preserve manual line breaks. Select a font that covers the input.
